mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand) signals economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in expansionary periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in UNRATE above 4.2% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, signaling tight labor markets and strong growth expectations.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.1pp in the next month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in triggered instances are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or UNRATE does not exceed 4.3% in the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly decline in FEDFUNDS below 4.33% signals an easing monetary policy cycle, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window or 60-day returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly UNRATE crossing above 4.3% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, indicating labor market tightness and growth anticipation.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 4.3% in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns in triggered instances are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or UNRATE does not cross 4.3% in the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both GDPC1 (demand) and RSAFS (demand) signals robust economic activity, leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns through expanded corporate investment and consumer spending.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or 60-day returns in interaction periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly INDPRO crossing above 104.0 triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, reflecting increased supply-side capacity and market optimism.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO crosses above 104.0 in the next month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in triggered instances are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or INDPRO does not cross 104.0 in the next month.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), increased discount rates compress equity valuations, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns as investors anticipate higher interest rates.
failure_condition: 20-day returns in tightening regimes are not significantly negative (t-test p < 0.05) or FEDFUNDS does not indicate a tightening cycle (e.g., remains below 4.33% for 3 months).

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE rising above 4.3%), increased labor demand signals strong growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns in tight labor markets are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or UNRATE does not indicate a tight labor market (e.g., remains below 4.3% for 3 months).
